[to office-manager]

Team, I've noticed the conference room projector is flickering intermittently during meetings. I'll submit a maintenance request today and will update you once I have a confirmed repair date.

I can help with the travel dates. Based on the client visit schedule, the arrival should be the 12th and departure the 16th, with no airline restrictions on file. Let me know if you need anything else before booking.

Just a heads-up: I’ll also check the secondary conference room’s AC while the tech is on-site Thursday, in case it’s due for a tune-up. That way we can knock out both at once and avoid another call-out fee later.
